entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... uhm... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought last week.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Sure, it's Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF789012. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, you can check my history.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. I can see you received the VeloBand just five days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the tracker? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. It's just... I guess I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and honestly, I really don't use it. With things being so tight, I was just hoping I could get the money back. I feel a bit silly calling about it.
Not at all, Sarah, I completely understand. Thank you for being upfront about it. Let me just pull up our current policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was just really hoping it wouldn't be a problem.
Alright, I've got it here. In some cases, for a change of mind, we might point customers toward our VeloFit resale marketplace, but looking at your purchase date, that won't be necessary at all.
Oh? So... so I can't return it?

No, sorry, I mean the opposite! You absolutely can. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, and since you only received it five days ago, you're well within that timeframe for a full refund. We can process this for you right now.
Oh, wow! That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac! I was so worried.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
That's wonderful. You've really made my day. Thank you again.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a great day!
